name: Ethical Leadership
description: The governing body should lead ethically and effectively, ensuring that the organization's culture is aligned with integrity and transparency.
outcome: Ethical culture and robust organizational integrity

name: Strategy and Performance
description: The governing body should appreciate that the organization's core purpose, strategy, risks, and opportunities are inseparable elements of the value creation process.

name: Risk Governance
description: The governing body should govern risk in a way that supports the organization in setting and achieving its strategic objectives.
outcome: Adequate internal controls and operational resilience

name: Compliance Governance
description: The governing body should govern compliance with applicable laws and adopted, non-binding rules, codes, and standards.
outcome: Effective compliance structures and regulatory safety
